simple.meaning: הֹצֶן (hôtsen) is a Hebrew word meaning “a weapon of war.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֹצֶן (H2021) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in הֹצֶן (H2021) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: הֹצֶן (hôtsen) / H2021 is traced through Ezekiel 23:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
